0022600028.text: The Utah Jazz (1-7, 14th in the West) visit the Dallas Mavericks (4-4, 11th in the West) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, with Utah on a six-game losing streak and 0-3 on the road. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Dallas won the most recent meeting 138-120 in Dallas on January 17. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Max Christie is day-to-day with a hip injury.
